description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to amend the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2103/33 that published the Duties & Functions effective from 07.03.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification amends ministerial portfolios and assigns specific responsibilities to government ministries. It names the President (Maithripala Sirisena) as the authority making these changes and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities for multiple ministries (Defense, Finance, Housing/Construction/Cultural Affairs, Telecommunications/Foreign Employment/Sports), including specific subject matter areas and institutions under each ministry's purview. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it contains both named government personnel and detailed portfolio responsibilities.
